args.subject: Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! I'm Emma Johnson, and I wanted to reach out to give you a warm welcome as you join our team next week.

We're thrilled to have you joining us in the marketing department. I know starting somewhere new can be a bit overwhelming, so please don't hesitate to reach out if there's anything I can help you with as you get settled in — whether it's a quick question, a need for resources, or just a friendly chat.

Looking forward to working with you!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
